items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: At that school that’s where Andre Watts used to attend... I went there for a year and a half.

ctx.x: And you just read it off and that’s it. I didn’t care too much, like I said, for the rock music because it was based on the blues, it was very simplistic [scats]. I said what is that? That’s nothing. But now it’s much better because you have better musicians playing it. More creativity and people that know something about music that have put their input, their compositional skills into rock and it sounds better. Sure. So I stayed with my four to the bar. And it seemed as if I’ve gotten more requests for that than…
Really. This is supposedly a classical institution? Is that right?
